text: This report provides information about the Auditor General's Office 2023 activities and the financial and non-financial benefits achieved by the City through its implementation of report recommendations. In 2023, the Auditor General's Office presented eight audit, investigation, cybersecurity, and other reports. The findings and recommendations in these reports focused on: - strengthening the safety of the City's IT systems and critical infrastructure against cyber attacks, including those of the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) - improving how the City procures and manages its Winter Maintenance contracts and holds contractors accountable to the contract terms - improving the management of contracts and costs of modular housing built to address the housing needs of residents - strengthening Toronto Building’s inspection function which contributes to safe buildings - minimizing asset…
